description: High-level, high-performance dynamic programming language for technical computing

layers.name: Runtime Layer
layers.description: Core C/C++ runtime implementation including garbage collection, JIT compilation, type system, method dispatch, threading, and platform abstraction
submodules: JIT/Codegen (codegen.cpp, jitlayers.cpp, llvm-*.cpp, llvm-*.h, passes.h, objcache.cpp)
Platform Support (src/support/ - dtypes.h, platform.h, ios.h, hashing, etc.)

layers.name: Compiler Layer
layers.description: Julia compiler implementation (Compiler.jl) written in Julia - type inference, optimization, SSA IR, effects system
submodules: Type Inference (typeinfer.jl, abstractinterpretation.jl, typelattice.jl, typelimits.jl, abstractlattice.jl)

layers.name: Frontend Layer
layers.description: Parser (JuliaSyntax) and AST lowering (JuliaLowering) - transforms source code to Core.IR

layers.name: Base Library Layer
layers.description: Core standard library loaded at startup - fundamental types, collections, I/O, math, runtime internals
submodules: Type System (number.jl, int.jl, float.jl, complex.jl, rational.jl, bool.jl, char.jl)
Collections (array.jl, abstractarray.jl, dict.jl, set.jl, bitarray.jl, iddict.jl)
I/O (io.jl, iostream.jl, iobuffer.jl, stream.jl, file.jl, filesystem.jl, coreio.jl)
Math (math.jl, floatfuncs.jl, gmp.jl, mpfr.jl, combinatorics.jl, special/)
System/OS (process.jl, cmd.jl, libdl.jl, libuv.jl, c.jl, env.jl)

layers.name: Standard Library Layer
layers.description: Independently loadable standard library packages - math, system interfaces, developer tools, JLL wrappers
submodules: Core Libraries (Base64, Dates, DelimitedFiles, InteractiveUtils, Libdl, Logging, Markdown, Mmap, Printf, Random, REPL, Serialization, SHA, Sockets, Tar, UUIDs, Unicode, Zlib)
System/Platform (Artifacts, LazyArtifacts, Downloads, NetworkOptions, FileWatching, Distributed, Future, LibGit2, PCRE2)
JLL Packages (*_jll - LLVM, OpenBLAS, OpenLibm, OpenSSL, LibUV, LibGit2, MPFR, GMP, PCRE2, Zstd, etc.)

layers.name: CLI/Entry Point Layer
layers.description: Command-line interface, dynamic library loader, and platform-specific entry points
submodules: Loader (loader.h, loader_exe.c, loader_lib.c, loader_library_probe.c, loader_symbol_probe.c, loader_win_utils.c)

layers.name: Build/Infrastructure Layer
layers.description: Build system, external dependencies, patches, and contributed scripts
submodules: External Libraries (deps/openblas.mk, deps/gmp.mk, deps/mpfr.mk, deps/libuv.mk, etc.)

layers.name: Documentation Layer
layers.description: User manual, developer documentation, and docstrings

layers.name: Test Layer
layers.description: Test suites for runtime, compiler, base, stdlib, and frontend

relationships.description: CLI loader initializes and embeds the Julia runtime
Runtime loads and initializes Base library at startup
Base provides core functionality that stdlib packages extend
Runtime calls into Compiler.jl for JIT compilation
Compiler uses JuliaSyntax for parsing and JuliaLowering for lowering
Frontend lowers AST to Core.IR which runtime executes
Build system compiles C/C++ runtime and manages dependencies
Build system handles Compiler.jl and frontend packages
Build system creates system image with Base
Build system handles stdlib packages and JLLs
